title: A shared setting changes under a module that relies on its old value
class: Config or default change against a dependent module
story: A raises LOW_STOCK in config.ts from 5 to 10, so the shop page warns shoppers earlier. B adds a restock list in index.ts that names the products at or below LOW_STOCK, which is 5 on B's base and exactly what B's requirement says. Together, the restock list also names a product with 8 left.

a.why: warn shoppers when ten or fewer are left

fact.sentence: The shop page warns when ten or fewer of a product are left

b.why: a restock list for the stock room

fact.sentence: The restock list names the products with five or fewer left

resolution: config.ts gains RESTOCK_AT = 5 for the restock list; LOW_STOCK stays the shop page's warning level.
